findings.description:
GaussianMath.evaluate(GaussianMath.Curve,uint256,uint256,int256) (contracts/src/GaussianMath.sol#49-67) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- ratioWad = distance * WAD / curve.sigma (contracts/src/GaussianMath.sol#60)
	- exponentWad = ratioWad * ratioWad / (2 * WAD) (contracts/src/GaussianMath.sol#61)
findings.disposition: Reviewed: deliberate fixed-point quantization; bounded numerical error and exact remainder-based grid rounding are specified and tested.

findings.description:
DistributionMarkets.normalizeOutcome(uint256,int256) (contracts/src/DistributionMarkets.sol#158-172) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- quotient = numerator / denominator (contracts/src/DistributionMarkets.sol#165)
	- outcomeWad = quotient * step (contracts/src/DistributionMarkets.sol#169)
findings.disposition: Reviewed: deliberate fixed-point quantization; bounded numerical error and exact remainder-based grid rounding are specified and tested.

findings.description:
DistributionMarkets.createMarket(DistributionMarkets.MarketConfig,DistributionMarkets.Curve) (contracts/src/DistributionMarkets.sol#110-146) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp >= config.closeAt || config.closeAt >= config.resolveBy (contracts/src/DistributionMarkets.sol#116)
findings.disposition: Reviewed: intended deterministic deadline guards; timestamps are not used for randomness. Consensus clock and trusted-resolver assumptions remain disclosed.
